changes.before: Related-family wording grouped editorially with POD-DHAGA-099 for deliberation before action to avert trouble; no textual descent asserted. Literal reading: If you act with understanding and consideration, misfortune will not befall you. Odia meaning: ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି କାମ କଲେ ପ୍ରମାଦ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁଛି। ଏହାକୁ ଆମେ କାମର ଅର୍ଥ ଓ ପରିଣାମ ବିଚାର କରି ଆଗେଇବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ବିଚାର କଲେ ସବୁ ବିପଦ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ମୂଳର ଭଲେ ଶବ୍ଦଟି ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ଅନୁବାଦରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିକୁ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ ଅନୁସାରେ ବିପଦ ନପଡ଼ିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନିଆଯାଇଛି। Interpretive reading: Understanding and consideration come before the action. Our editorial reading takes the couplet as encouragement to think through a situation and its consequences before proceeding. Its categorical promise gives the advice force; thoughtful action can still meet unforeseen trouble. Exact uploaded ଭଲେ retained without correction. Its precise final-word nuance remains uncertain; the whole clause is translated contextually as misfortune not befalling one, without adding forehead imagery. Rendered page31 inspected17November2026; source quotation has unknown rights and is excluded from the collection’s original editorial-content licence.
changes.after: Related-family wording grouped editorially with POD-DHAGA-099 for deliberation before action to avert trouble; no textual descent asserted. Literal reading: If you act with understanding and consideration, misfortune will not fall to your lot. Odia meaning: ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି କାମ କଲେ ପ୍ରମାଦ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁଛି। ଏହାକୁ ଆମେ କାମର ଅର୍ଥ ଓ ପରିଣାମ ବିଚାର କରି ଆଗେଇବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ବିଚାର କଲେ ସବୁ ବିପଦ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦୂର ହେବ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ଭାଲ ଅର୍ଥ କପାଳ ବା ଭାଗ୍ୟ; ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ ଭାଗରେ ବିପଦ ନପଡ଼ିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି। Interpretive reading: Understanding and consideration come before the action. Our editorial reading takes the couplet as encouragement to think through a situation and its consequences before proceeding. Its categorical promise gives the advice force; thoughtful action can still meet unforeseen trouble. Original uploaded final word ଭଲେ is preserved here as evidence; display repairs it to ଭାଲେ using the published counterpart in Namita Paikray’s story at https://odishasambad.in/saradshashi-a-story-for-children-by-namita-paikray-2/ (concluding paragraph, inspected19November2026). The counterpart differs elsewhere (କର୍ମ rather than କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ); only the missing vowel is repaired. ଭାଲ means forehead or fortune; falling to one’s lot carries the latter sense naturally. Rendered page31 inspected17November2026; source quotation has unknown rights and is excluded from the collection’s original editorial-content licence.
